## Data Exploration

## Analysis GSE67333

Load Library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(DEXSeq)
library(BiocParallel)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
```

```{r}
load(file = "/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata")
```

```{r}
isoform_counts_GSE67333 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE67333")
```

```{r}
gene_counts_GSE67333 <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(
  isoform_counts_GSE67333
)
```

```{r}
dir.create("data/processed/GSE67333", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

metadata_GSE67333 <- readr::read_csv("data/metadata/GSE67333_metadata_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Control", "AD")),
    sex = factor(tolower(sex)),
    age_scaled = as.numeric(scale(age))
  )

stopifnot(all(metadata_GSE67333$sample_id %in% colnames(gene_counts_GSE67333)))
stopifnot(all(metadata_GSE67333$sample_id %in% colnames(isoform_counts_GSE67333)))

gene_counts_GSE67333 <- gene_counts_GSE67333[, metadata_GSE67333$sample_id]
isoform_counts_GSE67333 <- isoform_counts_GSE67333[, metadata_GSE67333$sample_id]

saveRDS(gene_counts_GSE67333, "data/processed/GSE67333/gene_counts.rds")
saveRDS(isoform_counts_GSE67333, "data/processed/GSE67333/isoform_counts.rds")
saveRDS(metadata_GSE67333, "data/processed/GSE67333/metadata_aligned.rds")
```

```{r}
# Load exact transcript-to-gene annotation used by the course function
tx2gene_df_GSE67333 <- readr::read_rds(
  "/home/projects/22140/exam_data/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds"
) |> 
  dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::distinct(transcript_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
dds_qc_GSE67333 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(as.matrix(gene_counts_GSE67333)),
  colData = as.data.frame(metadata_GSE67333),
  design = ~ sex + age_scaled + condition
)

keep_genes_qc_GSE67333 <- rowSums(counts(dds_qc_GSE67333) >= 10) >= 3
dds_qc_GSE67333 <- dds_qc_GSE67333[keep_genes_qc_GSE67333, ]

vsd_GSE67333 <- vst(dds_qc_GSE67333, blind = TRUE)
pca_data_GSE67333 <- plotPCA(vsd_GSE67333, intgroup = c("condition", "sex", "age", "apoe_genotype"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar_GSE67333 <- round(100 * attr(pca_data_GSE67333, "percentVar"))

ggplot(pca_data_GSE67333, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = condition, shape = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - GSE67333",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_GSE67333[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_GSE67333[2], "% variance")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
ggplot(pca_data_GSE67333, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = age, shape = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - GSE67333 colored by Age",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_GSE67333[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_GSE67333[2], "% variance")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
vsd_corrected_GSE67333 <- vsd_GSE67333
assay(vsd_corrected_GSE67333) <- limma::removeBatchEffect(
  assay(vsd_GSE67333),
  batch = metadata_GSE67333$sex,
  covariates = metadata_GSE67333$age_scaled,
  design = model.matrix(~ condition, data = metadata_GSE67333)
)

plotPCA(vsd_corrected_GSE67333, intgroup = "condition") +
  ggtitle("PCA - GSE67333 with age and sex correction") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
